stemMd: What does “variation” refer to in this passage?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Changes in the colour of the route map.

options.label: B
options.textMd: A mathematical error in calculating the mean.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The number of different ticket prices.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Differences in journey duration from one trip to another.

explanationMd: The passage contrasts a narrow range of trip durations with a wide one. “Variation” names that dispersion around the average. It is a real feature of journey times, not evidence that the mean was calculated incorrectly.

distractorRationale.a: The subject is travel time, not visual design.
distractorRationale.b: The averages can be accurate while durations vary.
